posts.title: The Next Decade Belongs to People Who Redesign Their Jobs Now.
posts.description: Most conversations about AI and work get stuck on the wrong question: “Will AI replace my job?” That question is too blunt to be useful. It treats a job as a single, indivisible thing, when in reality, every job is a bundle of smaller pieces. If you want to stay useful in the age of AI, you need a more accurate lens. posts.title: Authentically Being vs. Seeming in an AI Era
posts.description: When intelligence can be simulated and communication can be generated, authenticity can no longer be read from the surface of things. It has to be located somewhere deeper.

posts.title: When AI Makes Your Job Easier, You'll Get More Work (Not Less)
posts.description: Experts predicted that super-accurate AI radiology would kill radiology jobs. Instead it increased demand. This is Jevon’s paradox, and it’s going to happen in your industry too.
